chapters.title: Why most Power Apps look amateur

takeaways: Horizontal and vertical containers replace fragile X and Y formulas, so layouts adapt automatically across desktop, tablet and phone.
A shared component library centralizes headers, buttons and branding, so one update propagates consistent design and accessibility across every app.
Containers, component libraries and a Center of Excellence turn citizen development into governed creativity that scales without rework.
hook: Are your Power Apps a patchwork of misaligned buttons and layouts that break on mobile? This episode is for Power Apps makers and Power Platform governance teams who want professional, consistent apps. Learn how containers and component libraries deliver responsive, on-brand design without positioning formulas.
